packs.description: Uses of packs, by a name of your choosing, such as drivers.

directive.description: The name of an //adder: directive, such as route.

dirs.description: Slash-separated glob patterns relative to the repository root. ** matches any number of directories.

partials.description: Templates whose {{ define }} blocks every template can use, as path.Match patterns relative to this file.

derive.description: Files rebuilt from scans of the repository's code by adder derive.

scans.description: What to read from the code, by the template field that holds the results.

scan.description: Selects items from the code: functions and methods by default, or types, values, files, or a custom scanner's items.

exclude.description: Directories to leave out, in the same syntax as dirs.

buildTags.description: Custom build tags to treat as set, such as integration.

typeCheck.description: Load type information, for filters that compare types rather than spelling.

platform.description: With typeCheck, the GOOS/GOARCH to check. Defaults to linux/amd64.

funcs.description: Filters functions and methods. Unset filters match everything.

name.description: Names containing a match for this regular expression.

receiver.description: Methods on this type, with a value or pointer receiver.

firstParamName.description: Declarations whose first parameter has this name.

firstParamType.description: Declarations whose first parameter has this type, with full import paths.

types.description: Selects type declarations instead of functions.

name.description: Names containing a match for this regular expression.

kind.description: Structs, interfaces, or any other type declaration.

implements.description: With typeCheck, types whose values or pointers implement this interface, with its import path.

values.description: Selects constants and variables instead of functions.

name.description: Names containing a match for this regular expression.

type.description: The type as written, which a const group repeats.

files.description: Lists files of any kind instead of Go declarations.

name.description: File names, with their extension, containing a match for this regular expression.

scanner.description: Runs a custom scanner from a pack in a repository's own build of adder.

output.description: A file rendered from a template with the results of every scan.

template.description: The template, relative to this file, or to the pack with pack.

path.description: Where to write the file, relative to the repository root. A template with each.

each.description: A scan whose items each get a file of their own, as .Item.

generators.description: Commands that create new files from templates, as adder new <name>.

generator.description: A command that creates files from templates, run as adder new <name>.

inputs.description: Values given to the generator, as name=value arguments or with --inputs, and read as .Inputs.<name> in templates.

message.description: A template printed after the files are created, such as next steps.

tests.description: Sample inputs and the files the generator should create from them, for adder test.

deprecated.description: Marks the generator as on its way out, saying what to use instead.

pattern.description: A regular expression the whole value must match.

valuesFrom.description: Takes the allowed values from a scan, written Scan.Field.

unique.description: Rejects values a scan already has, written Scan.Field.

deprecated.description: Marks the input as on its way out, saying what to use instead. A deprecated string input needs a default.

template.description: The template, relative to this file, or to the pack with pack.

path.description: Where to create the file, relative to the repository root. A template.

when.description: A bool input that includes the file.

unless.description: A bool input that excludes the file.

ifExists.description: fail, the default, or skip for a file that may already exist. adder never overwrites a file.

test.description: Inputs and the files the generator should create from them.

name.description: The test's name, unique among the generator's tests.

want.description: The directory of the files the generator should create, relative to this file.

use.description: One use of a pack, with the options it gives.

rename.description: New command names for the pack's generators.

tests.description: Tests of the pack's generators, by command name.
